premises.text: Finding a great car deal in MENA is hard due to no centralized platform, inconsistent illegitimate information, and no standardized pricing
premises.evidence_span: there's no centralized platform, inconsistent and illegitimate information, and no standardized pricing in the MENA region

premises.text: An AI-powered search engine consolidates country-wide listings with photo-based valuation and market-adjusted pricing
premises.evidence_span: SEAS condenses the entire search process into one transparent and AI-powered search engine

premises.text: An AI negotiation chatbot contacts dealers to negotiate final prices on the buyer's behalf
premises.evidence_span: our AI negotiation chatbot, Caesar, automatically contacts every single dealer

premises.text: WhatsApp integration lets buyers contact sellers and book test drives

premises.text: Monetization includes sending featured-car leads to OEMs and certified dealers
